description: conservationFastaFiles of a stored request: request schema 9 (v0.14.5) wrote one file reference or null per ring; schema 10 writes the list of the ring's comparison genome files (none for a ring without one). Python's decoder (tests/test_ring_genome_files.py) and the Web promotion (tests/web/session-request.test.mjs) read each schema 9 value as its schema 10 value.
